description:
Start an agent: a new session on this host, optionally with its first message.
Answers with its id, model, working directory, where its gates go, and its
status. The model is `<connection>/<model>`; omitted, it takes past picks.

autonomous.description: Run without anyone at the gate: calls the permission rungs do not clear are declined rather than held.

config.description: A config file to seed the session's `config.toml` from, instead of the project template.

cwd.description: The working directory, relative to yours; defaults to yours.

detached.description: Let it outlive you. By default an agent ends when the session that created it ends.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the main model, as the provider names its levels.

intent.description: Why this call, now — one line. See the guidance on `intent` in your instructions.

name.description: The id, a single path segment. Minted (`adjective-noun`) when omitted.

temperature.description:
Sampling temperature, 0–100 (percent). 0 is (near-)deterministic; omitted
uses the provider default.

upstream.description: Pin an OpenRouter session to these endpoints, in order (`google-ai-studio`, `google-vertex/global`); the request fails rather than falling back past them. Repeatable.

worktree.description: Give it its own checkout and branch to commit on, so its edits do not land in your tree. Without it, it works where you work (in your worktree, if you have one).

name: agents__create

description:
Send an agent a message. From a session that drives it — the one that created
it, its supervisor, or the operator — the message is its next user message, and
an empty one continues it; from anyone else it is a note the agent may set aside.
The answer says which happened.

intent.description: Why this call, now — one line. See the guidance on `intent` in your instructions.

reply_to.description: The seq of the question this answers, as the agent's status gives it.

text.description: The message. Empty continues an agent you drive.

name: agents__message

description:
Decide the call an agent is holding for a decision. `allow` runs it, and a
message rides with its result; `deny` refuses it — with a message the agent goes
on under it, and a bare deny ends its turn; `escalate` leaves it held and passes it
to whoever decides above you, with a message as a note to them.

intent.description: Why this call, now — one line. See the guidance on `intent` in your instructions.

message.description:
With `allow`, a note the agent reads with the call's result; with `deny`, the
message it goes on under; with `escalate`, a note to whoever decides next.

seq.description:
The held call's seq, as the agent's status gives it (`8`, or `8.2` for one of
several calls).

name: agents__decide

description:
Stop what an agent is doing now. A running tool is stopped (a command with its
process group) and the agent's turn ends; its next turn reads that you interrupted
it. A generation in flight ends and the agent goes idle.

intent.description: Why this call, now — one line. See the guidance on `intent` in your instructions.

name: agents__interrupt

description:
End an agent, and the agents it created that end with it. Their logs stay on
disk.

intent.description: Why this call, now — one line. See the guidance on `intent` in your instructions.

name: agents__archive

description:
Where an agent stands and the call that answers it. With no agent, one line for
each agent in view.

agent.description: The agent's id; omitted, every agent in view.

intent.description: Why this call, now — one line. See the guidance on `intent` in your instructions.

name: agents__status

description:
Read what an agent said and did: its messages in full, and each call on one line
with what became of it. By default, what is new since your last read; `seq`
reads one entry in full.

intent.description: Why this call, now — one line. See the guidance on `intent` in your instructions.

seq.description: One entry in full, by its seq (`8`, or `8.2` for one of several calls).

tail.description:
Read only the last this many conversation lines (a call and its outcome are one
line), extended back so no result shows without its call. `audit` counts log
entries.

name: agents__transcript

description:
Hand your work to a new session in this directory, which starts from the
project's current config and takes your place: the operator's clients move to
it, and it archives you once it has no more questions. The brief is its first
message. Always put to the operator; say so before calling it.

brief.description:
What the new session needs to start: what the operator wants done, what
was decided, and anything it should ask this session about before
archiving it. Written for the new session, not the operator.

intent.description: Why this call, now — one line. See the guidance on `intent` in your instructions.

name: agents__hand_off
